part.text: Found the bug at dictutils.py:361. The comparison `other[selfk] == self[selfk]` is computed but its result is discarded — the code always returns `True` regardless of value equality.

part.text:
All 435 tests pass.

The fix at `boltons/dictutils.py:361` — the `OrderedMultiDict.__eq__` branch for plain mappings (with `.keys`) was comparing `other[selfk] == self[selfk]` but discarding the result, so any mapping with the same keys compared equal. Changed it to `if other[selfk] != self[selfk]: return False`.
